geometry_model.backgate_coupling: channel overdrive += EOT / (Tbox + Tsi/3) * VBG; relative VBG=0 calibration; valid while |EOT / (Tbox + Tsi/3) * VBG| <= 2 V (linear coupling, depleted back interface); larger values are refused
geometry_model.backgate_scope: front-channel current only: VBG does not store holes in the body in this model, so with the channel off (V_G below about -1.5 V) V_LU and V_LD hardly change
geometry_model.body_capacitance_scaling: Cf + Cb - Cb0; Cb0 is reference-calibration counterterm
geometry_model.domain: L > 2 w_d0(Nbody) + 1 nm (neutral lateral base); Nbody with an avalanche-field table reaching 3 V reverse bias; |EOT / (Tbox + Tsi/3) * VBG| <= 2 V
